title: DangerXPfarm
description: High-risk XP zones with customizable grace periods, damage, and visual borders.
body:
# 💀 DangerXPFarm
**Turn specific areas of your world into high-risk, high-reward XP zones!**

DangerXPFarm allows server admins to create custom regions where players gain XP levels just by standing inside. But be careful—after a short grace period, the environment becomes hostile and starts damaging players!

---

## 🚀 Features
* **Custom Regions:** Create any size zone using a visual wand tool.
* **XP Rewards:** Automatically grant XP levels to players within the zone.
* **Danger Logic:** Players take damage if they stay too long (configurable).
* **Visual Borders:** See exactly where the danger starts with red particle outlines.
* **Persistence:** Regions save automatically and survive server restarts.

## 🛠 Commands
* `/dxp wand` - Get the selection tool.
* `/dxp create <name>` - Define your new XP zone.
* `/dxp delete <name>` - Remove a zone.
* `/dxp list` - List all zones with click-to-teleport support.
* `/dxp reload` - Reload the config.yml.

## ⚙️ Configuration
You can customize everything in the `config.yml`:
* XP amount per second.
* Damage amount per second.
* Grace period (how long players are safe before taking damage).
* All chat messages and prefix.
